result.title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
result.summary: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. Fuse Desktop, an open-source local version, is available at https://github.com/project-numina/fuse-desktop.

AI.brief_summary: 论文介绍 Numina Fuse——一个面向 Lean 4 数学形式化的 agent 原生应用，围绕人类对 agent 工作的监督来设计，包含蓝图、依赖图与代码视图以及可无人值守运行的后端，并报告其在三维 Kakeya 猜想形式化中的使用与 prover 模型研究。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将「派生项目状态」与编排逻辑分离、由 orchestrator 自主调度专门代理与并行子代理、并以 Lean 编译结果核验产物的设计，可能为 LVR 中的长时状态维护、并行假设分支与外部验证驱动的停止/贡献分配提供问题表述线索；但完全不含视觉或多模态推理，联系需较多核查。
